csv_project_name: Developers for Kent Home Affordable Housing Development
csv_scope_of_work: The Kent HOME Consortium: consisting of Kent County and the City of Wyoming, operating through Kent County s Community Action Department, is seeking project proposals from eligible non-profit developers to newly construct or rehabilitate existing single-family homes. The Non-profit developer(s) is to manage all project permitting and engineering components, procurement of contractors, oversight of construction activities, marketing, homebuyer application review, and eventual sale to an eligible household.

title: Developers for Kent Home Affordable Housing Development
short_description: Affordable housing developer solicitation for new construction or rehabilitation of single-family homes.
project_scope: The Kent HOME Consortium, consisting of Kent County and the City of Wyoming, seeks proposals from eligible non-profit developers for the new construction or rehabilitation of existing single-family homes for affordable housing. The developer is to manage permitting and engineering, contractor procurement, construction oversight, marketing, homebuyer application review, and sale to eligible households.
services: Design-build/developer services including project permitting, engineering coordination, contractor procurement, construction oversight, marketing, buyer application review, and sale administration.
relevance_explanation:
- Residential single-family affordable housing is generally not a core sbp focus.
- No indication of complex structural systems, long spans, bridges, roofs, or special structures.
- Scope is primarily developer-led project delivery and housing management rather than specialized structural engineering.
- Could include some engineering input, but the tender is not targeted at structural design excellence or innovative construction.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The source only mentions new construction or rehabilitation of single-family homes under the Kent HOME Consortium, without number of units, sizes, or funding amount, so no realistic USD estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The notice is an advance notice for non-profit developers and does not state planning or engineering fee amounts.
references_qualifications: Eligible non-profit developers are sought. No specific reference projects, minimum number of references, or detailed qualification criteria are stated in the notice.
contracting_authority: Kent County Purchasing Department, Kent County, Michigan, USA. Location: Wyoming, MI. Contact: okke. Phone: 616-632-7720. Fax: 616-336-2440. Email: purchasing@kentcountymi.gov.
notes: Advance notice only. The RFP/Q has been rejected and may be re-advertised in the future. IMS requests no phone calls, no faxes, and no contact with the agency at this time. Stage: Advance Notice.
